name: BreadcrumbSeparator
description: Icon placed between breadcrumb items, a slash by default, hidden from assistive technologies. Renders an `<li>` element.

props.name: children
props.description: Icon shown as the separator, such as a chevron icon. Replaces the default slash icon.

props.name: render
